about: Dorval is a city on Montreal’s West Island in Quebec, on the shore of Lake Saint-Louis beside Montréal–Trudeau International Airport. A historic waterside core, marina character, and major airport employment define a compact on-island municipality. Highways 20 and 520 frame its edges. About 19,000 people live in Dorval.
